title: Penalties for Employers who Implement Attendance-based Incentive Schemes
what_it_is: Penalties for Employers who Implement Attendance-based Incentive Schemes

sections.label: Work pass privilege penalties
sections.summary: Suspension of work pass privileges can last up to 24 months, so the penalty remains effective even if an employer does not hire foreign workers when first imposed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This specific question is related to his supplementary question yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I understand the penalty is the curtailment of work pass privileges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But could I ask how many companies, including SMEs in Singapore, do not hire foreigners?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And two, what then is the penalties for these companies that do not hire foreigners, since curtailing their work pass privileges will be ineffective?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fact, the majority of employers here employ foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As the suspension of work pass privileges can last up to 24 months, the penalty is still effective, even if the employer does not hire any foreign worker when the suspension was first imposed.
